title: server: implement validate_antithesis
description: Implement server function to validate antithesis patterns in task requirements. The antithesis validator checks that requirements properly define counter-examples and alternative perspectives to ensure comprehensive coverage of edge cases.

ubiquitous: THE SYSTEM SHALL validate antithesis patterns for all incoming task requirements
THE SYSTEM SHALL log validation results for audit purposes

event_driven.trigger: WHEN a task with antithesis requirements is submitted
event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL validate that the antithesis properly contradicts the thesis
THE SYSTEM SHALL return a structured validation report

unwanted.condition: IF the antithesis does not properly negate the thesis
unwanted.shall_not: THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT mark the validation as passed
unwanted.because: invalid antithesis patterns lead to incomplete requirement coverage

unwanted.condition: IF required antithesis fields are missing
unwanted.shall_not: THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT proceed with validation
unwanted.because: incomplete data would produce unreliable results

preconditions: Input task must contain a valid thesis statement
Input task must have an antithesis section defined
Server must have access to the validation ruleset
postconditions: Validation result contains a boolean pass/fail indicator
Validation result includes specific failure reasons if applicable
Validation result includes suggestions for improvement
invariants: Original input data shall not be modified during validation
Validation logic shall be deterministic for identical inputs
Error states shall always provide actionable feedback

happy: Given a valid thesis and properly negating antithesis, when validate_antithesis is called, then validation passes with success status
Given a task with multiple antithesis statements, when validate_antithesis is called, then all statements are validated and results are aggregated
Given a well-formed antithesis with clear contradiction logic, when validate_antithesis is called, then the validation report includes the specific contradiction points verified
error: Given a task missing antithesis section, when validate_antithesis is called, then validation fails with MISSING_ANTITHESIS error code
Given an antithesis that restates the thesis, when validate_antithesis is called, then validation fails with NO_CONTRADICTION error code
Given malformed JSON input, when validate_antithesis is called, then the function returns a parsing error without crashing
